test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

ABUSE
solution: The correct answer is '**Harm**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Abuse**' is '**Harm**'. • **Abuse**: to use something in a bad or dishonest way. किसी वस्‍तु को बुरे या ग़लत ढंग से प्रयुक्त करना • *Example: The politician was accused of **abusing** his position in order to enrich himself.* • **Harm**: to cause injury or damage; hurt. चोट या क्षति पहुँचाना; नुक़सान करना • *Example: Too much sunshine can **harm** your skin.* **Correct Answer:__** *Harm.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Terminate**: to end or to make something end. समाप्‍त होना या करना • **Use**: to do something with a machine, an object, a method, etc. for a particular purpose. विशेष प्रयोजन से किसी मशीन आदि से कोई काम करना, (का) प्रयोग करना • **Close**: to shut बंद करना या होना 34:T700, The correct answer **'often come here'.**
